req.title: PUT rejects unknown player
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when PUT targets a playerId that does not exist.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-012 requires that PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} returns HTTP 404 when the squad_number does not exist. The endpoint uses squad_number as the natural key. Tests must cover: (1) a positive case confirming an existing squad_number returns non-404 (proving the 404 path is conditional, not universal); (2) a negative/error-path case confirming a clearly non-existent squad_number returns exactly 404; (3) boundary cases at the edges of the known data set (squad_number 0, 27 — just outside the seeded range of 1-26) to catch off-by-one mutations. All tests use FastAPI TestClient in-process, exact status code assertions, and valid request bodies matching the path squad_number to avoid the 400 branch.

tests.name: test_put_existing_player_does_not_return_404
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 players, squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 10 (Messi) exists in the database
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with a valid body where squad_number=10
expected: Response status code is NOT 404 (existing player is found)
Response status code is 204 (successful update) or 500 (db bug in source), but never 404
trace: R-PLAYER-012: 404 must only occur for unknown players; known players must not trigger 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_existing_player_does_not_return_404():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Lionel",
        "middleName": "Andrés",
        "lastName": "Messi",
        "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "RW",
        "team": "Paris Saint-Germain",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": True
    }
    r = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code != 404
    assert r.status_code in (204, 500)

tests.name: test_put_unknown_player_404_not_other_error
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with squad numbers 1-26 only
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/100 with a valid body where squad_number=100
Assert status is exactly 404, not 400, not 200, not 204, not 500
expected: Response status code is not 400 (body mismatch branch not triggered)
Response status code is not 204 (success branch not triggered)
Response status code is not 500 (db error branch not triggered)
trace: R-PLAYER-012: only 404 is acceptable for unknown player; decision table covers all branches
DT: body squad_number matches path (avoids 400), player absent (triggers 404 not 204/500)

    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 500
